title: crash in torch.nn.functional.interpolate

labels.name: module: error checking
labels.description: Bugs related to incorrect/lacking error checking

labels.name: triaged
labels.description: This issue has been looked at a team member, and triaged and prioritized into an appropriate module

labels.name: module: edge cases
labels.description: Adversarial inputs unlikely to occur in practice

body:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

code
```
import torch
print(torch.__version__,flush=True)
data = [
    [
        torch._empty_affine_quantized(
            (8, 6, 0, 7), scale=0.07663195986552764,
            zero_point=85, dtype=torch.quint8
        ),
        202
    ],
    {},
    [],
    {}
]
torch.nn.functional.interpolate(*data[0],**data[1])
```
crash in local(2.8.0a0+gitba56102) and colab(nightly 2.9.0.dev20250906+cpu)
